div.div:
dunedaq v3.1.0.
Focus on CCM.->switch to Kubernetes
Ability to subscribe to ERS messages and opmon info data.
Ability by CCM to disable/restart applications, including commands to the peer applications that need to be notified.
CoreSW: Emulated software support for TDE;
Readout/Trigger: Full integration of TPG FW impl.
DQM: demonstrate simple DQ assessment capability.
DQM: run just-in-time and DQM backend containerised and managed by sysadmins.
